President Trump has repeatedly demanded loyalty from allies and party members. This has led to friction with Congress and international partners, as he views disagreement as a personal betrayal rather than a policy difference.

The Poison:
Demanding loyalty as obedience rather than shared purpose creates a fragile, high-strain environment where dissent is punished, not debated.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Plane error: The administration confuses WHO (the leader) with WHAT (the institution). It is a bait-and-switch where personal loyalty replaces constitutional duty.

Social Physics Analysis:
By demanding obedience, the administration creates a loop of fear. This prevents the integration of diverse perspectives, leading to a brittle and unstable political coalition.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. The focus on obedience over policy creates systemic decay.

The Unavoidable Truth: True leadership thrives on diverse input, not enforced conformity.

The Unavoidable Lie: Personal loyalty is the same as national interest.
